status: registered before full validation and pilot controller benchmarking
physics: NEC-2 free-space PEC wire network; 81 segments per wire; 161-segment audit
training_gate: physics_gate.passed and beneficial pair moves at single-flip local optima
primary_budget_selection: 10 ms if all main methods have zero observed validation misses; otherwise first feasible larger listed budget. No feasible budget means report infeasibility, not a speed claim.
temporal_precoder: all-OFF RZF from last observed network, identical across predictors including oracle
objective: minimum of two users' spectral efficiencies; 0.1 W incident BS power waves; 1 MHz thermal noise, 290 K, 7 dB NF
observation_assumption: perfect historical complete multiport impedance matrices; acquisition cost excluded and not demonstrated practical
physics_ablation: zero inter-RIS off-diagonal impedance in controller belief only; evaluate every returned action on the same fully coupled truth
attention_scope: two-layer width-32 four-head atom attention over per-atom coupled-network features; no explicit learned graph edge bias
statistics: paired trajectory means, seed averaging within trajectory, descriptive bootstrap intervals with only three pilot trajectories
headroom: enumerate 2016 pairs per parent on train/validation only; include conditional beneficial pairs with harmful single flips
mesh_followup: refine predeclared frames 0,32,48 and audit selected configurations; report any sub-mesh-uncertainty optimizer differences
